subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: What public reset-start policy should OpenClaw expose for bare `/new` and `/reset` across static acknowledgements, startup/model turns, prompt text, greeting suppression, and optional cheaper greeting-model routing?
rationale: The remaining work adds compatibility-sensitive config and changes session-start and model-routing semantics, so automation should not invent the key shape or default behavior.

options.title: Add Unified Reset-Start Policy
options.body: Add one typed policy covering startup turns, prompt text, suppression, and greeting-model routing while preserving the maintainer-chosen default behavior.

options.title: Keep Acknowledgement-Only Default
options.body: Keep bare resets as static acknowledgements and document `/new <model>` or `/new <message>` for users who want a model turn, without adding a new config surface yet.

options.title: Restore Startup Turns By Default
options.body: Make bare resets run the startup/model turn again and intentionally accept the token-cost, latency, and upgrade behavior change.

recommendation.title: Add Unified Reset-Start Policy
recommendation.body: Add one typed policy covering startup turns, prompt text, suppression, and greeting-model routing while preserving the maintainer-chosen default behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current bare reset acknowledgement contract and prior policy review, making it the best available owner for the default/config decision.
